# Genuine Commander actions: approach, enter, look, drive, park, release.
start
press forward
frames 100
release forward
press interact
expect helm 1 0
expect held 0 0
press look-right
frames 30
release look-right
expect heading 0 0.00001
press forward
frames 120
release forward
expect speed 6 0.00001
expect robot-z -6 0.00001
press park
expect parked 0 0
frames 100
expect speed 0 0.00001
expect parked 1 0
expect robot-z -10.5 0.00001
press forward
frames 90
press interact
expect helm 0 0
expect held 0 0
press backward
frames 100
release backward
expect parked 1 0
expect speed 0 0.00001
expect grounded 1 0
